name: paypal-checkout-error-message-matching
hook: Error detection must use .includes() not === for multi-variable env errors
body: When detecting missing payment credentials from getPaymentEnv(), use .includes() substring matching rather than exact string matching. getPaymentEnv() throws 'Missing required payment environment variables: PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID, PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET, PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID' but the checkout route was checking for 'Missing PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID or PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable' (exact match) which never matched.
why: The exact-match approach breaks whenever getPaymentEnv() changes its error message format. The PayPal 500 bug in #2408 was caused by this exact string mismatch.
